test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper( Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rohan is Sumit's brother. Sumit wants to marry Sujata. Sujata is the daughter of Hari Chand. Rohan wants to divorce Sunita. Sujata and Sunita are sisters. How is Hari Chand related to Rohan?
solution:
• Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2224c1c989f25b6e9780b5293027a990568840c2b08eb5ad155ceee6e32899c.png] 

1) Rohan is Sumit's brother. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6b5c13a8b232d6f3fe43c85f2ce3c7115e5306cebc536ff2c04837e0d4ff390.png] 

2) Sumit wants to marry Sujata.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac93f6dfcf5ac707bc4314bf42e0d4b3e2ac1aa15b1dac521065d0799a056a95.png] 

3) Sujata is the daughter of Hari Chand.

4) Rohan wants to divorce Sunita.

4) Sujata and Sunita are sisters.

 
• The family tree will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/403382b9b396c35844ad117bb596b3af6516f214ed865ef97dba462ca64fe61c.png] 

 
• Here, Harichand is either mother-in-law or father-in-law of Rohan.
 
• Because mother-in-law is not given in the options, Harichand is the father-in-law of Rohan.

Hence, 'father-in-law' is the correct answer.
